description: This PHP source file defines a validation rule class named TimesheetDateRule within the OrangeHRM system. The class checks if a given date is valid for timesheet entry by comparing it to the current date and existing timesheets for an employee.

classes.name: TimesheetDateRule
classes.description: A validation rule that ensures a timesheet date is not in the future and that the employee hasn't already submitted a timesheet for that date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with an employee number.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input date is acceptable for a timesheet entry.
